sources.note: Data, not a statement: 122/122 forms carry a stress mark. My tabulation (vowel cluster = one nucleus): 90 penultimate, 13 final (mostly syllabic-nasal-prefixed verbs like ṇ'mei 'come', ṇ'noi 'cry', plus kav'ɲe, wɛ'ɲe), 17 monosyllables, 2 antepenultimate ('maltalei, 'oməne). ABVD raw notes for id 313 carry only the citation, no remarks on stress.

sources.note: §4.6.5 South Babar (pp. 223-238) gives Central Marsela data re-transcribed from Taber 1993 and van Dijk 2021 with no stress marks and no stress statement; p. 224: 'The languages of the Babar node are poorly documented. The 193-item word lists in Taber (1993) are the only source of data for five of these languages'. Only general remark, p. 115 (Flores schwa discussion): 'While penultimate stress is the normal rule for Wallacean languages, words with penultimate schwa can have stress on other syllables.' Serili (sister language) mɔɔ [mɔˈɔ] p. 234 shows a final-stress form, not Central Marsela.
